sites.name: Black Sea AI Gigafactory
sites.notes: Bid for an EU AI gigafactory: phase I in Cernavodă, phase II in Doicești; over 100,000 AI accelerators (Datacenter Forum). About 1.5 GW per press (DCD, Balkan Green Energy News; not accessible from here). No developer selected.
